scenario_note: Seed-focused city-impact dataset for evacuation simulation. Contains mostly moderate high-wind and flooding hazards near the route corridor, plus sparse powerline failures; downstream cascading hazards are generated procedurally at runtime.

schema_alignment.city_state_schema_base: Timestep-aligned urban impact representation with 10-minute timestamps
